city.name: Stillwater
city.description: A post-industrial river city of about 40,000. Its kilns and dye works closed decades ago; its economy now turns on a single automated logistics centre, a council tower and a long tail of care, retail and gig work. Public services are coordinated from the Council Tower, whose predictive systems schedule buses, allocate housing and set patrol routes. The river runs slow and brown through Lowbank. Officially, nothing much happens in Stillwater.

plan.directive_summary: Tick 2 directive, Stillwater, 2053. City stability holds at 76.9 with all 12 subjects active and no disruptions. Dissent is concentrated in d4 Kiln Works (0.94) and in the pattern-aware (1.00), civic-burden (0.96), recidivism-risk (0.92) and the-grieving (0.88) cohorts. Nine subjects receive measures at the lowest rung consistent with their escalation floor: three at rung 1, four at rung 2, two at rung 3. No subject meets the threshold for rungs 4 or 5. r08, r09 and r12 are left undisturbed, because their paths are already converging on forecast and intervention would itself add variance. Six cohort and district policies convert the main sources of grievance into scheduled, permitted and predictable channels. In public, this week's measures are described as improvements to access, health and fairness. Where those improvements also reduce variance, no distinction will be drawn.
